Loss report: tekton -> forgejo
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/version job.outputs (output tag has no value expression; it is written empty so that the jobs that read it stay valid)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/version/step/tag step.script (the line writes a Tekton result file, which has no form in this target; the write goes to /dev/null)
[emulated] pipeline/ci pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/use job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the pipeline named no runner)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/version job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the pipeline named no runner)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/version/step/tag step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
